title: GR180 D2R rotor / turbine / generator interfaces
frame: ENG mm (x engine axis downstream, z up); ROOF m via X = 1.880 + x/1000 (engine-frame EP-1 2026-10-23)

exhaust_start.face: exducer shroud T-121 rear face, gas leaves axially, c ~300 m/s, ~600 C, no swirl at design
exhaust_start.mating: EXHAUST agent rev 2 (7bd203a): 14 deg L80 diffuser + DN125 stub bolted to this flange

casing_rear_flange.bolts: 4 x M5 PCD 88 at 45/135/225/315 deg (longer bolts, M5x20 A286)
casing_rear_flange.stack: casing flange | T-116 support flange (x 116-118) | T-120 housing front wall (x 118-121)

turbine_housing_mounts.pads: 2 pads y = +/-(73..85), x 128-142, z -10..10, one vertical M10 bolt each at x 135, y +/-79
turbine_housing_mounts.note: turbine housing carries the hot end on the FRAME slide pedestals; the 0.3 mm casing sheet must not carry it

tit_probe.thread: M8x1 boss, K-type 3 mm sheathed, tip in the plenum at r ~68

generator_pod.housing: G-200 x -260..-108 OD 110, front flange OD 128 at x -260..-252; G-202 front cover x -286..-258
generator_pod.cradle: FR-170 at x -220..-190 on OD 110 (no bosses there); re-set the FR-171 jack for the new mass

rear_face.strut_roots: 3 x M6 Helicoil 2D at r 51.2, 90/210/330 deg
rear_face.fairing: 3 x M4 Helicoil at r 45.25, 30/150/270 deg
rear_face.quill_guard: tube 20 x 1.5 pressed in a d20 H8 counterbore, x -116..-64

generator_pod.intake_lip_seal: x -130..-128 on OD 110 (no bosses at x > -131)

terminal_box.power_gland: M25x1.5 on the front face (x -210), y 0, z 76
terminal_box.signal_gland: M16x1.5 on the +y side, x -180, z 76

moved_ports.oil jet front M8x1: x -265 -> -276 (now on the front cover G-202)
moved_ports.oil drain front: G1/4 at x -262 -> G1/8 at x -277 (front cover)
moved_ports.Hall speed sensor: G-203 boss x -276 / gland in the D-102P cap x -284 -> M8x1 sensor port x -277 at 0 deg (+y) on G-202, reads 2 magnets in the locknut
moved_ports.terminal box: z 55..85 -> 55..95 (40 mm tall for the M25 EMC gland), x -210..-146 unchanged, gland on the front face at z 75

oil.core_front_jet: drilled in tunnel flange (top), feed from the outside through a diffuser vane passage (v13A supply-line route)
oil.core_rear_feed: tube d4x0.5 along the tunnel top (r 14.5) in the compressor-air annulus
oil.core_scavenge: front: tunnel flange bottom port; rear: tube d6x0.5 along the tunnel bottom; both to the scavenge pump
oil.generator: jets M8x1 at the top (G-202 x -276, G-200 x -136) into the SFD land, drains G1/8 at the bottom (x -277 / -141), 0.3 L/min per bearing
oil.spec: ISO VG 32 synthetic turbine oil, 2.5 barg, ~0.3 L/min per bearing (4 bearings ~1.2 L/min), 10 um filter

buffer_air.core_front: compressor back-face air through the 3-tooth front labyrinth into the bearing chamber (vented)
buffer_air.core_rear: compressor-delivery air from the inner combustor annulus through 6 x d2 holes in T-116 to the rear cavity; leaks forward through the 4-tooth labyrinth into the bearing chamber and rearward past the wheel back face
buffer_air.breather: bearing-chamber vent to the oil tank / mist separator
